title: Age of Empires
notes: A classic strategy game that lets you explore, acquire resources, and enegage in war. Music is great. There are a lot of redudancies in the selectable empires.

title: Age of Mythology
notes: A fun twist on the strategy RTS formula with the addition of ancient myths. Good campaign, good music, good times.

title: Assassin's Creed: Syndicate
notes: Cool imagining of victorian London. It maintains the annoying parts of the Assassin's Creed formula and adds more tedious combat

title: Battlefield: Bad Company 2
notes: Cool that most buildings are destructible. Gunplay is good. Story is kinda meh

title: Battlefield 3
notes: Cool "edgy" music but bland military movie shooter

title: Battlefield: Hardline
notes: Cool idea where you play as a cop but most missions suck

title: Battlefield V
notes: Beautiful WW2 shooter. Nothing more.

title: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons
Brütal Legend
notes: Interesting idea of a game. 3rd person open world action game that expands into an RTS in a rock opera setting. I was disappointed by the open-worldy mechanics of the game and certain elements of the story were kinda boring. However, I appreciate Double Fine's creativity in this outing.

title: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare Remastered
Call of Duty: World at War
notes: Cool campaign, music, and has zombies. Maybe I'm just tired of WW2 shooters that aren't innovative.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II
Call of Duty: Ghosts
notes: Boring ass story. Same Call of Duty nonsense.

title: Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare
notes: Very mid game with some cool moments. Kevin Spacey did a pretty good job.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III
notes: Mid game that continues the future aspects of Call of Duty. Tries to do a Bioshock type moment but writing is nowhere close.

title: Call of Duty: WWII
notes: A worse WW2 shooter than World at War (which was good).

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops: Cold War
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II
Dear Esther
notes: Interesting idea, essentially started the walking sim genre but not interactive enough for me.

title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution: Director's Cut
The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
Halo 4
notes: Downfall of Halo. Why bring back Master Chief for a lackluster campaign.

title: Halo 5: Guardians
notes: Not Halo anymore

title: Homefront
notes: Trash

title: Jazzpunk: The Director's Cut
notes: Weird little indie game that words cannot describe. I guess you are a spy?

title: The Last of Us: Part II
The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
South Park: The Stick of Truth
South Park: The Fractured but Whole
Spider-Man
notes: Move tie in game with Tobey and Willem Dafoe

title: Star Wars: Battlefront II
notes: DICE knows how to make those good looking games but I don't think they've ever written a good game

title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (Console)
notes: Cool power fantasy in the Star Wars Universe. However, the PSP/PS2/Wii version of the game is much better.

title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II
notes: Story ruins the endings from the first game. Pretty much a shinier version of the first game but now you hold 2 lightsabers (backwards).

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Blacklist
notes: If Sam Fisher, who should be like 50, had Nathan Drake's agility. Cool ability to mark and execute and spy thriller elements are cool. But short campaign and weird retcons in the story.

title: Unpacking
notes: Cozy organizing game. Got tedious for someone like me. It's like a fancy fidget toy.
